observations: Wooden bed frame with a light oak-style laminate finish.
Headboard features a grid-like panel design.
The frame consists of a headboard, two side rails, and a footboard.
No mattress support (slats or boards) is visible inside the frame.
The item is photographed outdoors on a paved surface.
Watermark 'THE YOUNG FURNITURE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is present on both photos.

claims.evidence: The item is being sold in a second-hand context, though it appears clean in photos.
Photos show the exterior but do not show the internal joints, underside, or the presence of all assembly hardware.
Only one unit is shown in the provided photos.

risks.risk: Missing mattress support (slats or base boards).
risks.proof: A photo showing the interior of the frame with slats or a solid base installed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a frame only, requiring the buyer to purchase or build a base.

risks.risk: Damaged or missing assembly hardware (screws, brackets).
risks.proof: A photo of the hardware kit or the internal corner joints.

risks.risk: Material is low-grade particle board prone to swelling or stripping.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of an unfinished edge or a drill hole.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as basic laminated particle board.

proof_requests: Photo of the slats or base boards that support the mattress.
Photo of the assembly hardware (screws and brackets).
Exact dimensions of the frame (width and length) to determine mattress size.
Close-up photos of the corner joints where the rails meet the headboard.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a bed frame. It can be priced based on the visible components, assuming the worst case that slats and hardware are missing or need replacement.
